description: Table for one preflop game and stack, in big blinds: seats, stacks, blinds (sb 0.5, bb 1), ante, antePostedBy, stackIncludesAnte, openSizes (first-in raise-to), evUnit, evBaseline. Convergence is not published. stackIncludesAnte is true: the named depth is the starting stack and the 1bb BB ante is posted from it. openSizes at 40bb is open 2.2x (listing 2.2bb; node decodes code 40034 to 2.19bb) and SB 2.8x (2.8bb). 10bb is all-in/fold versus 50bb stacks, so stacks is null there. evs on nodes are small blinds relative to fold. Example: get_config({ game: "nlmtt8", stack: 40 }).

game.description: "nl" = no-limit hold'em 6-max cash (169-grid hands, per-hand EV in small blinds), "nl9" = no-limit hold'em 9-max cash, "nlmtt8" = no-limit hold'em 8-max MTT chip-EV (10–300bb, 1bb BB-ante; Fold/Call/Limp/AI/Open/3B tokens), "nlh8-hydra" = no-limit hold'em 8-max MTT chip-EV with a classic 0.1bb ante from every seat (10, 20, 30, 60bb; same tokens as nlmtt8), "plo" = pot-limit Omaha 6-max cash (4-card), "plo5" = pot-limit Omaha 5-card 6-max (100bb, 1.2bb ante), "plo9" = pot-limit Omaha 9-max cash, "plo6hu" = 6-card Omaha heads-up (BTN vs BB, 100bb). Cash trees are not tournament, ICM, PKO, or satellite solves. nlmtt8 is chip-EV only.

stack.description: Stack depth in big blinds, e.g. 40
